title: Don't Say Good Luck
plot_overview: A high school student lands the lead in her school musical, where auditions, rehearsals, friendships, and the pressure to perform fill her days. As difficulties at home begin to take up more space, she must navigate the demands of adolescence while school life and family concerns unfold side by side.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this heartfelt coming-of-age story if you like school musicals, friendship, and family drama, with a gentle emotional tone; Not for you if you want a fast-paced or highly original story.
review_summary: Pros: heartfelt coming-of-age story; relatable school life; tender performances | Cons: familiar genre beats; predictable moments; sometimes overtly emotional
